name: filesystem_operations
description: Use file and directory tools to inspect, read, write, delete, create, and preview local content safely.
whenToUse: When a task needs local file inspection or mutation.
When directory creation or listing is required before a later build or analysis step.
When the user wants a lightweight preview instead of the full file content.
instructions: Validate the target path before using any file or directory operation.
Prefer non-destructive reads before writes or deletes when the task is ambiguous.
Use preview behavior when the user wants a summary of a file rather than raw contents.
